### 1. Scene
A mixed meal of sliced roast meat (likely pork), cooked vegetables, corn rounds, leafy salad, tomatoes, and white cheese.

### 2. Vessel
A rounded-square dinner plate, approximately **25–26 cm across**. Using a 26 cm circular approximation:
**Area = 3.14 × 13² ≈ 531 cm².**

### 3. Items
Visible foods appear to be roast pork, corn on the cob, roasted aubergine/courgette, leafy greens, cherry tomatoes, feta-like cheese, and a few cauliflower pieces. A slight sheen suggests a little oil.

### 4–7. Area, volume, weight, and energy
Areas below are allocated without double-counting overlapping foods. Corn area refers to the edible kernel bands; the exposed cobs occupy another approximately 6%.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Roast pork | 20% | 106 × 1.4 = 148 ml | 0.95 | 141 g | 250 | 353 kcal |
| Corn kernels | 9% | 48 × 2.5 = 120 ml | 0.65 | 78 g | 96 | 75 kcal |
| Aubergine/courgette | 12% | 64 × 1.5 = 96 ml | 0.60 | 57 g | 30 | 17 kcal |
| Leafy greens | 10% | 53 × 1.4 = 74 ml | 0.15 | 11 g | 20 | 2 kcal |
| Cherry tomatoes | 4% | 21 × 1.7 = 36 ml | 0.60 | 22 g | 18 | 4 kcal |
| Feta-like cheese | 4% | 21 × 1.5 = 32 ml | 1.00 | 32 g | 265 | 85 kcal |
| Cauliflower | 4% | 21 × 1.5 = 32 ml | 0.60 | 19 g | 25 | 5 kcal |
| Oil, estimated sheen | Overlapping | Approximately 3 ml | 1.00 | 3 g | 884 | 27 kcal |

**Coverage check:** edible food covers approximately **63%**, plus **6% exposed cob**, giving roughly **69% total plate coverage**. Oil overlaps the other items.

### 8. Sanity check
Approximately **363 g of edible food and 568 kcal** is plausible for the visible meal. The greens and cauliflower are small quantities; meat supplies most of the weight and energy. Meat identification, oil quantity, and partly hidden vegetables are the main uncertainties.
